first_step_test: One broad upright fruit body with an oval top rim fixes width, crown attachment and face placement before details.

source.notes: Second generated five-panel contact sheet approved after first privately rejected for rind-line disappearance. Raw approved and rejected sheets are retained in drafts.

final_elements.name: pineapple body
final_elements.description: One upright tapered fruit body with a flat base and a closed narrow oval top rim for the crown.

final_elements.name: five crown leaves
final_elements.description: Five pointed crown leaves grow from the body's top opening, middle leaf tallest.

final_elements.name: left sunglass lens
final_elements.description: One broad rounded dark lens sits high on the left half of the body.

final_elements.name: right sunglass lens
final_elements.description: One matching rounded dark lens sits high on the right, joined by a short bridge.

final_elements.name: sideways smirk
final_elements.description: One crooked half-smile sits below the glasses, without dot eyes.

final_elements.name: two rind chevrons
final_elements.description: Exactly one small V-shaped rind mark on each lower side of the body, clear of the smile.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: A few broken horizontal shadow strokes sit below the flat base.

frames.visible_job: Draw the broad fruit body and a narrow oval top rim.
frames.instruction: Draw one upright rounded pineapple body, wider in its lower half, and flatten its base slightly. Close a narrow oval rim across its top where the crown will attach.

frames.visible_job: Attach exactly five pointed leaves at the open top.
frames.instruction: Behind the oval top rim, grow five connected pointed leaves; make the middle leaf tallest and fan two shorter leaves to either side. Keep their bases touching the rim.

frames.visible_job: Add two joined lenses and one crooked smirk.
frames.instruction: High on the body, draw two broad rounded sunglasses lenses joined by a short bridge. Beneath them, add one off-center crooked smirk instead of dot eyes.

frames.visible_job: Add two small side chevrons and a broken ground shadow without moving the face.
frames.instruction: Put one small V-shaped rind mark on each lower side of the body, clear of the smile. Add a few broken shadow strokes below the flat base.

final_step.visible_job: Color only established fruit, crown, glasses and shadow shapes with streaky marker.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established fruit golden yellow, its five crown leaves bright green, and the sunglass lenses dark teal-blue. Keep the crooked smirk, two V-shaped rind marks and three ground strokes visible through the marker color.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop is one bold upright body with a narrow top oval and flat base; it fixes scale and gives the learner a clear crown attachment.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: All five saved crops were inspected consecutively. The top rim, five leaf tips and bases, two glasses lenses, crooked smirk, two V marks and three ground strokes stay in their assigned positions. No guides or unexplained losses appear; finish adds streaky marker color only.

transitions.observed_addition: The original body, flat base and top rim stay fixed; five pointed crown leaves attach behind the rim, with the middle leaf highest.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction calls for exactly five leaves behind the existing top rim, matching the saved crop.

transitions.observed_addition: The fixed body and all five crown leaves remain; two broad joined sunglass lenses and one right-rising crooked smirk appear on the body.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction names both lenses, their bridge and the off-center smirk visible in this crop.

transitions.observed_addition: The body, top rim, five leaves, both lenses and smirk persist; one V mark appears low on each side and three separate horizontal ground strokes appear below.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction matches the two side V marks and the three broken ground strokes, without claiming a full rind lattice.

transitions.observed_addition: The same five leaf shapes, body, rim, lens frames, smirk, two V marks and three ground strokes remain; green, yellow and dark blue marker fills occupy established regions.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction calls for those exact fills and keeps every black structural mark visible.
